description.value: Signature Trait. You are a machine-first being (Machina sapiens) - integrated, augmented, and no longer biologically human. Your body is a frame of alloy and synthetic tissue. You gain +1 Cognition, and choose one subtype adjustment (+1 Physique or +1 Reflex) and one damping (-1 Presence or -1 Resolve). Your Presence is capped below the normal tier ceiling and can never be bypassed.
